claims.claim_text: Date of Incident: June 24, 2020
Time of Incident: Approximately 0103 hours
Location: 22800 block of Loumont Drive, Lake Forest, CA
Reporting Officer: Deputy M. Calder
Badge Number: 7831
Subject: Female, approximately 25-30 years old, dressed in dark clothing
Deputy M. Calder, Badge Number: 7831
Deputy R. Vega
Deputy S. Whitfield
Deputy A. Navarro
No witnesses were present at the scene
On June 24, 2020, at approximately 0103 hours, Orange County Communications Center received a 911 call reporting a residential burglary at 22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest
The reporting party stated that someone had broken a rear window and entered the residence
The reporting party was a male caller who believed the intruder was still inside the home
Deputy Vega was dispatched to the call
Deputies Calder, Whitfield, and Navarro also responded
While en route, dispatch advised that the reporting party stated he was hiding in a bedroom closet
The call was subsequently disconnected
The dispatcher's attempts to reestablish contact were unsuccessful
At approximately 0109 hours, I arrived on Loumont Drive and turned off my emergency lights
I parked directly in front of 22851 Loumont Drive and exited my vehicle
Using my flashlight, I began walking eastbound along the north sidewalk toward the residence
I heard a noise to my left and observed a female subject standing on the north sidewalk approximately 40 feet from my position
The subject was dressed entirely in black, including a black hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up
I illuminated the subject with my flashlight and immediately observed that she was holding a black semi-automatic handgun in her left hand, pointed toward the ground
I drew my department-issued sidearm and began issuing commands
I yelled, "Drop the weapon! Let me see your hands! Get on the ground!"
The subject did not respond and remained motionless
I took cover behind the sedan
I broadcast over the radio that I had a subject at gunpoint
Deputy Vega arrived at approximately 0110 hours and parked approximately 20 feet behind my position
Deputy Whitfield took a position behind Deputy Vega's vehicle
At approximately 0111 hours, Deputy Navarro arrived and took cover position near the front of my vehicle
Over the following approximately ninety seconds, I repeatedly ordered the subject to drop the weapon and get on the ground
The subject stood still but appeared to be scanning the area, turning her head from side to side
At no point did the subject make any verbal response to my commands or those of the other deputies
At approximately 0111 hours and 30 seconds, the subject abruptly raised the handgun to shoulder level with both hands and aimed it directly at my position behind the sedan
I discharged my firearm five times at the subject
Deputy Whitfield simultaneously discharged his firearm three times
The subject fell to the ground and the weapon came to rest beside her
Deputies Vega and Whitfield approached the subject and secured the scene
Deputy Vega kicked the weapon away from the subject's reach
Upon closer inspection, the weapon appeared to be a realistic-looking semi-automatic pistol
Deputies immediately began rendering first aid
Orange County Fire Authority Engine #19 arrived at approximately 0119 hours and paramedics assumed medical care
The subject was transported to Mission Hospital by ambulance
The weapon recovered at the scene was later determined to be a Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, a realistic-looking replica handgun
The 911 call reporting the burglary had originated from the subject's own cell phone
No burglary had actually occurred at 22851 Loumont Drive
Patrol vehicle video recordings from responding units
Eight (8) cartridge casings recovered from scene
One (1) Daisy 340 BB Spring Repeater Pistol, black
Subject's clothing items with apparent blood
Subject's cell phone
One California Driver's License
Subject transported to Mission Hospital
Scene secured and processed by OCSD crime scene investigators
OCDASAU investigators responded
Deputy Signature: M. Calder
Date of Report: June 24, 2020
